sectors.trend: Coal boom supports energy miners; rare earths pipeline (Lindian, Barkly, Great Southern) shows strong project momentum; iron ore sentiment weak ('roaches seeth'); gold explorers (Kaiser, Great Southern) advancing
sectors.implications: Coal and rare earths names offer relative strength; iron ore majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face headwinds from weak pricing; gold juniors attract speculative flows

sectors.trend: Property investor credit growth crashes post-budget tax changes; negative gearing reform fails to ignite but housing slump persists; Macquarie audit bid signals M&A activity
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NPL pressure from property credit contraction; Macquarie (MQG.AX) audit bid adds near-term catalyst

sectors.trend: Oil surges on US-Iran flare-up and Hormuz concerns; diesel shock described as permanent; Danish wind farm entry breaks Australia's renewable drought; oil giant retreats from clean energy
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, AWE.AX benefit from oil spike; renewable names (SME.AX, IGR.AX) gain from Danish wind entry; diesel cost inflation pressures transport and logistics

sectors.trend: CSL.AX gains on US deal; weight-loss drug demand surges in August data; top central banker warns AI could trigger global downturn
sectors.implications: CSL.AX is a key positive catalyst; weight-loss drug demand supports CSL and HIC.AX; AI contagion risk adds macro uncertainty

sectors.trend: Qantas ground crews vote to strike; Star bleeds $307m with auditor doubts; Bathla warns of potential collapse; dupe brands and EV uptake accelerate
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational risk from strike vote; SWS.AX (Star) under severe distress; consumer shift to dupe brands pressures premium retailers (WES.AX, WOW.AX)

sectors.trend: Sydney house price crash goes global; property investor credit growth crashes; renters see respite; negative gearing reform muted
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure; residential property developers at risk; rental yield compression supports REIT income

Australian housing correction accelerating with global attention
Rare earths and critical minerals pipeline maturing
Domestic inflation complicating RBA easing path
Corporate distress in media (Star) and property (Bathla)

Coal boom vs. clean energy transition tension

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East escalation / oil price spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Hormuz shipping; diversify away from oil-sensitive transport names
Reduce exposure to property developers and high-LVR bank lending; favour cash-rich banks
Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor Qantas earnings guidance for strike impact
Avoid SWS.AX and Bathla exposure; monitor for contagion to media and property sectors
Maintain defensive allocation; monitor RBA and Fed commentary for policy response
Favour inflation-hedging assets (commodities, infrastructure); avoid long-duration bonds

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and energy producers on oil spike and coal boom
opportunities.rationale: Coal demand surging; oil at elevated levels on geopolitical risk; Goldman Sachs bullish on oil

opportunities.recommendation: Add rare earths and critical minerals exposure
opportunities.rationale: Multiple project milestones (Lindian, Barkly, Great Southern) signal sector maturation; policy tailwinds

opportunities.recommendation: Buy CSL.AX on US deal momentum
opportunities.rationale: US deal provides revenue visibility; weight-loss drug demand surging domestically

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight renewable energy on Danish wind farm entry
opportunities.rationale: Breaks Australia's wind drought; policy support likely to follow

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce property developer and high-LVR bank exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Credit growth crashing; Sydney crash global; Bathla near collapse signals sector stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX and SWS.AX pending resolution
defensive_moves.rationale: Strike vote and auditor survival doubts create binary downside risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge with gold and defensive staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Geopolitical oil risk and AI contagion warning warrant defensive positioning

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from oil-driven inflation fears, housing credit contraction, and corporate distress. CSL and coal names provide pockets of strength. Qantas strike and Star auditor issues add volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow range with elevated VIX.
market_outlook.long_term: Rare earths pipeline and renewable energy buildout offer structural growth. Housing correction may stabilise within 6-9 months. RBA constrained by domestic inflation, limiting easing. Coal boom may moderate as global energy transition accelerates. AI contagion risk remains a tail risk.
